# WaterShape

What a [WaterSurface](WaterSurface.md) covers.

## Values

- `rectangle`: A horizontal rectangle `extent` around `center`.
- `planet_sea`: The sea of the world's [Planet](Planet.md): water all the way around it, `sea_level` meters above its radius, filling every hollow of the ground below that height.
